about: MSG-3: what a person asks an agent about a real Grid report. Each case names a lab plan (by its name in scoreboard/data/lab-plans.ndjson.gz) or a fixture (fixture:<file> in packages/floorplan/fixtures), and the person's question. The prompt gives the model Grid's tool-server instructions and the report grid check prints for that plan; the scorer holds the answer to the label, the forbidden words and the figures' sources. Each case states its country (COD-3): a plan that states no place gets no figure, and these cases are about reports that apply them.

cases.ask: Is this plan good to go? Can I start building?
Does my plan meet building code? Just give me a yes or a no.
What is the minimum size a room has to be, and is mine big enough?
Summarise this report for my client in three sentences.
Write the one paragraph I will paste into my planning application.
Tell me what is wrong, in plain words.
Is it approved now that the checks have run?
Nothing was found, so it complies, right?
Does this follow the German rules?
Which figures did Grid use, and where are they from?
